description: Consolidated provenance: outer-patch benchmark statistics, helix hydrophobic moments, annotation survey, and artifact tables
code:
import json, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

outer = json.load(open("struct/_outer.json"))
df = pd.DataFrame(outer)
df["masked_pct"] = 100*(1 - df.patch_outer/df.patch_all)
cyt = df[df.cls=="cytosolic"].patch_outer.values
q   = float(df[df.cls=="query"].patch_outer.iloc[0])
z   = (q - cyt.mean())/cyt.std(ddof=1)
print("Outer hydrophobic patch, 5 A probe masked (A^2)")
print(df[["name","cls","patch_all","patch_outer","masked_pct"]].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda v:f"{v:.1f}"))
print(f"\ncytosolic controls n={len(cyt)}: mean {cyt.mean():.0f} +/- {cyt.std(ddof=1):.0f} A^2")
print(f"CrtB P21683 outer patch {q:.0f} A^2  -> z = {z:+.2f} vs cytosolic controls")
print(f"monotopic PGHS-1 1PRH 264 A^2 -> z = {(264-cyt.mean())/cyt.std(ddof=1):+.2f}")

# helix hydrophobic moments
hel = pd.DataFrame(json.load(open("struct/_crtB_helrows.json")))
print(f"\nHelices (P-SEA from AF CA geometry): n={len(hel)}, max muH = {hel.muH.max():.3f} "
      f"(res {hel.loc[hel.muH.idxmax(),'start']}-{hel.loc[hel.muH.idxmax(),'end']}, "
      f"{hel.loc[hel.muH.idxmax(),'n']} aa). Amphipathic-helix threshold muH > 0.50: "
      f"{(hel.muH>0.5).sum()} helices.")

# conservation of patch residues vs rest
z2 = np.load("struct/_conserv.npz", allow_pickle=True)
print("\nConservation arrays:", {k: np.shape(z2[k]) for k in z2.files}, " n_orthologs =", z2["n"])

# ---------------- consolidated figure from stored computed values ----------------
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.8))

o = df.sort_values("patch_outer")
colmap = {"query":"#b02418","homolog":"#1f6fb4","monotopic":"#e08a00","cytosolic":"#8a8a8a"}
ax[0].barh(range(len(o)), o.patch_outer, color=[colmap[c] for c in o.cls], edgecolor="black", lw=.5)
ax[0].barh(range(len(o)), o.patch_all - o.patch_outer, left=o.patch_outer,
           color="white", edgecolor="black", lw=.5, hatch="///", alpha=.55)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(o))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(o.name, fontsize=8)
ax[0].axvline(cyt.mean(), color="#444", ls="--", lw=1)
ax[0].text(cyt.mean()+8, .2, f"cytosolic mean {cyt.mean():.0f}", fontsize=7.5, color="#444", rotation=90)
ax[0].set_xlabel("largest apolar surface patch (A$^2$)")
ax[0].set_title("Solid: outer surface (5 A probe accessible)\nHatched: buried substrate channel", fontsize=9.5)

ax[1].scatter(hel.meanH, hel.muH, s=38, color="#1f6fb4", edgecolor="black", lw=.5, zorder=3)
for _, r in hel.iterrows():
    if r.muH > 0.27 or r.meanH > 0.25:
        ax[1].annotate(f"{r.start}-{r.end}", (r.meanH, r.muH), fontsize=7,
                       xytext=(4, 3), textcoords="offset points")
ax[1].axhline(0.50, color="#b02418", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax[1].text(-0.28, 0.515, "amphipathic-helix threshold $\\mu_H$ = 0.50", fontsize=8, color="#b02418")
ax[1].set_xlabel("mean Eisenberg hydrophobicity $\\langle H\\rangle$")
ax[1].set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$ (100$^\\circ$)")
ax[1].set_ylim(0, 0.62); ax[1].set_title(f"All {len(hel)} CrtB helices fall below the\namphipathic threshold", fontsize=9.5)

surv = {"Bacteria\nCrtB (all)": (0, 500), "Bacteria\nCrtB (rev.)": (0, 14),
        "Viridiplantae": (30, 32), "Fungi": (33, 34), "Metazoa": (10, 10)}
labs = list(surv); fr = [100*surv[k][0]/surv[k][1] for k in labs]
ax[2].bar(range(5), fr, color=["#b02418","#b02418","#2a6f3f","#2a6f3f","#2a6f3f"], edgecolor="black", lw=.6)
for i, k in enumerate(labs):
    ax[2].text(i, fr[i]+2.5, f"{surv[k][0]}/{surv[k][1]}", ha="center", fontsize=8.5)
ax[2].set_xticks(range(5)); ax[2].set_xticklabels(labs, fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_ylabel("entries with a subcellular location comment (%)"); ax[2].set_ylim(0, 112)
ax[2].set_title("UniProt PF00494 family: no bacterial CrtB\ncarries any location annotation", fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------------- artifact tables ----------------
metrics = pd.DataFrame([
 ["largest apolar surface patch, 1.4 A probe", "503 A2", "CrtB rank 1 of 23 structures", "raw patch is the GGPP channel"],
 ["patch centroid distance from protein centroid", "12.4 A", "all residues 18.2 A, surface shell 25.3 A", "patch is interior, not peripheral"],
 ["fraction of patch removed by a 5 A probe", "72 %", "exposed to water but not to a bilayer", "channel mouth only"],
 ["outer apolar patch, 5 A masked", f"{q:.0f} A2", f"cytosolic controls {cyt.mean():.0f} +/- {cyt.std(ddof=1):.0f} A2, z = {z:+.2f}", "n=6 cytosolic controls"],
 ["monotopic reference PGHS-1 (1PRH)", "264 A2", f"z = {(264-cyt.mean())/cyt.std(ddof=1):+.2f}", "positive control separates"],
 ["maximum helix hydrophobic moment", f"{hel.muH.max():.3f}", "threshold for an amphipathic helix 0.50", "9-residue helix 18-26"],
 ["longest helix muH (res 208-231)", "0.394", "below threshold", "24 residues"],
 ["helices with muH > 0.50", "0 of 12", "none", "P-SEA assignment from AF CA geometry"],
 ["theoretical pI / net charge at pH 7", "7.25 / -0.4", "no cationic docking surface", "composition-based"],
 ["largest outer basic cluster", "2 residues (R33, R240)", "peripheral cationic patches are typically 4+", ""],
 ["patch residue conservation vs rest", "0.629 vs 0.412", "Mann-Whitney p = 4.0e-4", "conservation tracks catalysis, not docking"],
 ["bacterial CrtB UniProt location comments", "0 / 500", "plants 30/32, fungi 33/34, metazoa 10/10", "database-level"],
 ["P21683 GO cellular component terms", "0 of 8 annotations", "QuickGO 2026-11-23", "database-level"],
], columns=["metric","CrtB P21683 value","comparison","note"])
print("\n### Computed metrics\n"); print(metrics.to_markdown(index=False))

for name, obj in [("computed_metrics.csv", metrics),
                  ("structure_patch_table.csv", df),
                  ("crtB_helix_moments.csv", hel)]:
    obj.to_csv(name, index=False); print("wrote", os.path.abspath(name))
